objective: All-question BCE, original multi-positive labels, no other loss
architecture: One 4-head self-inclusive attention block A=LN_A(h+drop(MHA(h))); P_i=h+drop(FFN_i(h)); N_i=LN_i; F_i=N_i(P_i). Common E:1024->128 and H:128->64->1. FFNs128->256->128. S0:A,F1; S1:F1,A; S2:P1,A,N1; S3:F1,F2,A; S4:F1,A,F2; S5:A,F1,F2.
initialization: Build original scorer first, append F2 only for double-FFN layouts. Common E/A/F1/H same-seed weights identical; F2 common across S3-5. Only forward order varies; no zero initialization or frozen branch.
optimizer: AdamW, weight decay0.001, gradient clip1; no LR schedule
budget: Every run exactly60 epochs, 19 updates per epoch, 1140 updates. No early stopping. Main30 runs fixed LR0.0003; sensitivity6 runs seed17 LR0.001. Sensitivity never selects main LR or final model.
sampling: Full train permutation per epoch with seed+10000; matched question order
normalization: Mean/std on all training embeddings only; fixed 4x1024 inputs; no text/question branch
checkpoint_selection: Highest official validation correct count over60 epochs, then lower validation BCE, then earliest epoch
final_selection: Use only30 main runs. Highest five-seed sum of official correct counts, ties lower parameters then protocol order. Export fixed seed17 single model, no ensemble.
secondary_comparisons: Extra-capacity layouts versus S0 are descriptive, not pure stage effects. Fixed epochs10/20/40/60 as well as best checkpoint. Same-seed17 second LR sensitivity only.
baseline_replay: S0 is exact prior architecture; first epochs at same LR/seed must reproduce old history through old early-stop endpoint. Full60-epoch selected score may differ from old early-stopped91.90% mean. Primary comparisons use newly trained S0.
uncertainty: 10000 paired question bootstrap samples over seed-mean correctness; report paired seed deltas and other-four-seed means. Reused validation and checkpoint selection, conditional descriptive intervals, no multiple comparison correction.
test_policy: No test training, selection, prediction or scores; official checker may check test integrity/alignment only.
